name: continentept-mcp

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Continente.pt catalogue. No login needed. Results keep the website's relevance order, with products from your saved favorites first, and show each price with what it is for (per item, piece, kg or litre), the pack size and productId. Reads at most five result pages, so completeness may be "unknown" for broad queries.

query.description: Search text, for example "leite meio gordo".

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by productId: price, availability and sale rules (sale unit, minimum, maximum and step). Check this before choosing a quantity for weighted or bulk products. No login needed.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: List the products saved as favorites on the account. Uses a local snapshot that is refreshed automatically when missing; snapshots older than 24 hours are marked stale. Pass refresh: true to fetch the current list from the website.

refresh.description: Fetch the current list from the website instead of using the local snapshot.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the shopping cart: each line with productId, cartItemId, kind (product or bag), quantity, unit price (per item or per kg) and lineTotal, plus the totals (products, bags, deposit, delivery, discounts and grandTotal, the amount to pay). Use it to check current quantities before changing them and to verify any uncertain change.

tools.name: add_cart_item
tools.description: Add an amount of a product to the cart, on top of any quantity already there. quantity is in the product sale unit (default 1). Use set_cart_item_quantity instead when the user wants a specific total. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

quantity.description: Amount to add, in the product sale unit (default 1).

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

tools.name: set_cart_item_quantity
tools.description: Make the cart hold exactly this quantity of a product, adding it if it is not there yet. Zero removes it. Pass cartItemId from get_cart when the product has more than one line. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

quantity.description: Desired total in the product sale unit. Zero removes the item.

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove a product line from the cart. Succeeds without changes if it is already absent. Pass cartItemId from get_cart when the product has more than one line. If the result has mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed: call get_cart before any further change and never repeat the request automatically.

productId.description: productId from another tool, such as "00123". A product slug ending in that ID (for example "leite-00123") also works.

cartItemId.description: Cart line identifier from get_cart. Required to select one of several lines for the same product.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List recent orders, newest first, with their product lines. Each order has an orderId for get_order. Use detailLimit or includeLines: false to read fewer details, and pass the returned nextCursor as cursor to continue.

includeLines.description: Read product lines for the returned orders.

detailLimit.description: Maximum returned summaries to enrich with lines; defaults to limit. Zero skips details.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get the product lines of one order by its orderId from list_orders (not the displayed order number).

orderId.description: Internal orderId from list_orders; distinct from the displayed order number.

tools.name: list_frequently_bought_products
tools.description: Rank products by how many recent orders contained them, with total quantities per unit. orderLimit sets how many recent orders to read (default 10); limit caps the products returned (default 25). Useful for building a usual shopping list.

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Report local state without contacting the website: browser status, whether credentials and saved cookies exist, the last observed login state and favorites snapshot freshness. Never returns secrets.

instructions:
Continente MCP shops at Continente.pt for one account. Checkout and payment always happen on the website.

- Quantities are in the product's sale unit. Call get_product before choosing a quantity for weighted or bulk products, and respect its minimum, maximum and step.
- set_cart_item_quantity sets an exact total (adding the product if needed; 0 removes it). add_cart_item adds on top of what is already there. When the user says how many they need, use set_cart_item_quantity.
- Change the cart one item at a time and read structuredContent.result before reporting success. confirmedQuantity is what the cart now holds.
- If a cart change returns mutation.outcome "unknown", the cart may have changed. Call get_cart and decide from its contents. Never repeat the change automatically.
- Money is EUR in integer minorUnits (129 means €1.29). Each price says what it is for: per item, per piece, per kg or per l. A price per kg or per l is not the price of one pack; check packageText and secondaryPrice before comparing. Missing prices, quantities or completeness stay unknown; do not guess them.
- If your client supports MCP prompts, the basket-planner prompt has the full workflow for planning a shopping list or basket.
